actions.label: Reproduce Keyboard Manager Right Alt to End behavior

reproduce.expected: The configured Right Alt mapping should emit End without an unintended Ctrl modifier, while native Ctrl+End and AltGr text behavior remain intact.
reproduce.module: Keyboard Manager Right Alt to End
steps: Map Right Alt to End on a test editor with multiple lines and compare an AltGr layout with a layout where Right Alt is ordinary Alt.
Record Ctrl/Alt state when End is emitted, compare line-end versus document-end navigation and check key-up cleanup.
Regression-check Ctrl+End, ordinary Right Alt shortcuts and AltGr characters before choosing any modifier suppression change.
prerequisites: Use a disposable test environment and test-owned documents/configuration; preserve existing user data.

known_information: The issue is already labelled reproducible and says Right Alt mapped to End moves to document end rather than line end.
Official guidance notes that AltGr can behave as Left Ctrl plus Right Alt; Ctrl+End is a plausible explanation for the observed navigation, not a measured event trace.
Current handlers contain modifier reset and special AltGr restoration paths, so the input-layout distinction matters.
inferences: The proposed mechanism is provisional and is not an executed runtime result or evidence that the old report is fixed.

issue_context.analysis: A layout that treats Right Alt as AltGr may leave a synthetic Ctrl component active when End is injected. Confirm the layout and emitted modifier state before changing AltGr handling; preserve ordinary Ctrl+End and international text entry.
